title: How Cross-Chain Message Passing Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Source["Source Chain"]
        U[User deposits token] --> GW["Gateway locks or burns"]
        GW --> EV[Emit deposit event]
    end
    EV --> ATT{"Attestation Layer"}
    subgraph Trust["Validators / Proof"]
        ATT --> SIG["Multisig, MPC or zk proof"]
    end
    SIG --> H["Destination Handler"]
    subgraph Dest["Destination Chain"]
        H --> CHK{"minted <= escrowed?"}
        CHK -->|Yes| MINT[Mint wrapped asset]
        MINT --> R[Recipient receives]
        CHK -->|No| REV[Revert message]
    end

title: Attack Vector
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Attacker] --> P1
    A --> D1
    A --> K1
    subgraph Deposit["V1: Wrong-token deposit"]
        P1["Call legacy deposit, token=0x0"] --> P2[safeTransferFrom is no-op]
        P2 --> P3[Zero asset actually locked]
    end
    subgraph Drift["V2: Collateral drift"]
        D1[Deposit fee-on-transfer token] --> D2[Records full amount]
        D2 --> D3[Receives less than recorded]
    end
    subgraph Admin["Admin abuse"]
        K1[Compromised admin key] --> K2["setPeer to fake ERC20"]
    end
    P3 --> MINT["Handler mints unbacked supply"]
    D3 --> MINT
    K2 --> MINT
    MINT --> DEPEG[Wrapped asset depegs]
    DEPEG --> DRAIN[Drain pooled collateral]

title: Defense Pattern
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    IN[Incoming deposit] --> G1{"token != address 0?"}
    G1 -->|No| REV1[Revert]
    G1 -->|Yes| G2{"Token in allowlist?"}
    G2 -->|No| REV2[Revert]
    G2 -->|Yes| BAL[Snapshot balanceBefore]
    BAL --> XFER[safeTransferFrom]
    XFER --> DIFF["credited = after - before"]
    DIFF --> DEC{"Decimals match dest?"}
    DEC -->|No| NORM[Normalize decimals]
    DEC -->|Yes| BIND[Bind token and amount]
    NORM --> BIND
    BIND --> INV{"minted <= escrowed?"}
    INV -->|No| REV3[Revert]
    INV -->|Yes| OK[Emit attested message]
    subgraph Hardening["Peer and admin hardening"]
        T1[Timelock on setPeer] --> T2[Multisig plus monitoring]
    end
